specs.title: H4 mobile modal traps focus, cancels its draft and applies only explicitly
H4 invalid ranges never call products, while failed masters allow sorting and retry
H4 removing the search chip leaves focus on the results heading
H4 mobile unchanged apply restores results focus and shows applied filter count
H4 visual surfaces keep desktop hierarchy and usable mobile toolbar
H4 home and catalog error or empty states preserve public navigation
home loads mock categories through Next → BFF and keeps featured omitted
search normalizes query, preserves URL and has working clear
query 1/121 characters never requests products
search returns real fixture matches and does not invent prices or stock
pagination retains criteria, updates focus and respects first/last
recoverable provider error stays an error, preserves q and retries
out-of-range page offers recovery without retry loop
unapproved URL criteria rejected and upstream details not exposed
slow old response cannot overwrite new query
mobile fits viewport, uses visible labels and exposes keyboard focus
query text is escaped and long query has no horizontal overflow
empty home omits category/featured headings and preserves navigation
invalid public payload is a recoverable error, never an empty catalog
F006 rejects duplicate home links while leaving global search usable
F007 retries a non-JSON gateway failure and announces fresh results
F008 mobile clear applies immediately, closes dialog and preserves context
F009 announces changed ordering and history restores sort, filter and page
F010 invalid page never requests products and explicit recovery retains filters and order
F-014: indeterminado con reintento no se convierte en agotado ni permite compra
F-013/F-012/F-014: la selección resuelve SKU, precio, stock y CTA
F-012: sin oferta no se inventa descuento y demo 4 sí la publica
F-014: los tres estados comerciales no exponen cantidades
F-015: tarjetas completas con enlace a la ficha
la tarjeta abre la ficha del producto correspondiente y conserva returnTo
Ficha MOCK muestra la región comercial F-012…F-015
producto inexistente responde HTTP 404 con estado neutral
slug especial 404 también responde HTTP 404
503 acordado → estado de error recuperable
504 acordado → estado de error recuperable
